scenes.caption: TB is down a fifth in nine years. Is that enough?
scenes.narration: India's TB rate has fallen by a fifth in nine years. Is that enough?

scenes.kicker: TB cases per lakh people, WHO estimate
scenes.label: 2015 to 2024
scenes.narration: WHO estimates India had two hundred thirty seven TB cases per lakh people in twenty fifteen. By twenty twenty four, one eighty seven.

scenes.title: Fall in TB rate, 2015 to 2024
scenes.caption: Faster than the world. Short of the target.
scenes.narration: That is a twenty one percent fall. The world managed twelve. But WHO's target for twenty twenty five was fifty.

scenes.caption: 92% coverage = reported cases ÷ a modelled estimate. Both moved.
scenes.narration: The headline ninety two percent coverage is reported cases divided by a model's estimate. Reported cases rose by half and the estimate fell. So it is an estimate, not a count.

scenes.label: of the world's TB cases are still in India
scenes.narration: India still has about a quarter of the world's TB cases.
